notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{C}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
